title: Understanding Logistic Regression
text: In logistic regression, the probability of the binary outcome is modeled using the logistic function. This function is defined as $$sigma(x)=\frac{1}{1+e^{\left(-x\right)}}$$. Can you see how this relates to the given equation?

title: Symmetry in Logistic Function
text: The logistic function has a property of symmetry. If you replace $$x$$ with $$-x$$, the function's output complements to $$1$$. How does this property help in understanding the given statement?

title: Exploring the Symmetry

title: Connecting the Dots
text: Now that you know the symmetry property of the logistic function, think about how this property applies to the equation $$P(Y=1|X)=P(Y=0|-X)$$.
